name: MeetWave
tagline: MeetWave is a privacy-first meeting assistant for Windows that records, transcribes and summarises your calls without ever joining them as a bot
description: MeetWave is a privacy-first meeting assistant for Windows that records, transcribes and summarises your calls without ever joining them as a bot. How it works - Captures Windows system loopback audio and your microphone in one session, so both sides of the call are recorded - Whisper transcription with speaker diarization, including long meetings - Claude and GPT turn the transcript into a structured summary: key points, decisions, action items with owners and deadlines, risks and blockers - Sha
